verdict.rationale: stagewise automatically generates a WORKSPACE.md file in .stagewise/ when a workspace is connected. That file is the agent's primary high-level understanding of the project and persists on disk, giving it a form of auto-built, reusable project context. SKILL.md files add persistent project-specific instructions, but users write those themselves rather than the agent building them. missing for 10: evidence that the agent automatically records and recalls learnings or facts from past sessions, documentation of whether WORKSPACE.md updates as work progresses, and independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-session recall.
